title: Goofy Controls
text: Goofy Controls. Quality and texture are fine, but sent it back due to the controls.  It is set to go off after two hours, you must then turn it off and wait at least one minute before restarting.  As if you are going to wake up during the night to keep doing this process.  If you are going to use it as a preheater it is a good value.
